# CredentialSignInStatus

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Pending"` | The person hasn't finished at the provider yet; poll again. |
| `"Complete"` | Signed in: the credential is saved. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CredentialSignInResult`](credential-sign-in-result.md)
